text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out and about, we decided to visit a shrine that was supposedly hosting an unusual festival—
However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*caw, caw...*)
choice_data_list: —You haven't done anything?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear? How strange.
This should be the right place, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It was an oversight on my part.
Apparently, the temple fair ended yesterday..."
choice_data_list: I'm really sorry...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Fufu, you don't need to look so down, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Fufu, you don't need to look so down, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, since we came all this way,
why don't we take a walk until the bus arrives?"
choice_data_list: It'll be about a five-hour walk, though...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That sounds nice too, but walking to the train station together would be great, right?
If you get tired, I'll give you a piggyback ride! Okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So peaceful~... The air is delicious,
or rather, it feels almost sacred...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, lanterns over there! Leftovers from yesterday's festival,
maybe? Such a 'wabi-sabi' vibe, love it♡
choice_data_list: ...You really wanted to see the festival, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Of course I was interested, but it's not like this is our only chance, right?
Let's come together again if we get another opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Such nice weather~.
Ah, look! I found a heart-shaped cloud!
choice_data_list: *pant*, *gasp*... Y-Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Are you okay? Shall we walk a little slower?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, isn't that a bench over there?
Let's walk up to it and take a quick breather!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: To the station... about halfway left. Let's take it easy♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Catching my breath on a bench, I was filled
with guilt. Wasting her precious time
all because of me...
choice_data_list: I'm so sorry, truly...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Why?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
There's not a single thing for you to apologize for.
After all... I'm so very happy right now.
choice_data_list: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
There really is nooooothing on this road, is there?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, it was unimaginably long,
just an endless stretch of green rice paddies and blue sky.
The shrine was just a modest, ordinary place too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Still... even an ordinary view like this has plenty of things to love about it.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The wind feels so nice. The grass smells so good.
The slow drift of the clouds is so soothing—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Being able to share such small, simple joys
with you, Trainer-kun...
...That alone makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Being able to share such small, simple joys
with you, Trainer-chan...
...That alone makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you think spending completely ordinary time
with someone you love... someone precious to you...
is the greatest, most wonderful luxury of all?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Spending ordinary moments together, happiness, richness—her words resonated deep within me, and my heart suddenly felt much lighter.
choice_data_list: Yeah... I'm so happy right now.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Fufu. Shall we get going soon?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Just being with you makes my legs feel so light, Trainer-kun.
So I'll give you a piggyback ride anytime!
choice_data_list: No, my feet are starting to feel light too!
No, my legs are feeling pretty light now too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"When I'm with you, Trainer-chan, my feet feel so much lighter.
So I can give you a piggyback ride anytime!"
choice_data_list: No, my feet are starting to feel light too!
No, my legs are feeling pretty light now too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Then let's walk together after all!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm ba~ck♡
That went by surprisingly fast, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After walking for over two hours, we finally got
on the train... It was a long journey home,
but it truly felt like it went by in an instant.
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, I had a great time.
I had fun, thanks to you.
With love, anything is possible!
You can do anything if you have love!
I'd love to spend time like this again.
I'd love to spend time like this again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After walking for over two hours, we finally got
on the train... It was a long journey home,
but it truly felt like it went by in an instant.
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, I had a great time.
I had fun, thanks to you.
With love, anything is possible!
You can do anything if you have love!
I'd love to spend time like this again.
I'd love to spend time like this again.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Same here! Thanks to you, Trainer-kun, I had so much fun♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Same here! Thanks to you, Trainer-chan, I had so much fun♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Because of each other,
we're always having fun and feeling happy.
Now this is what I call love♡, don't you think!
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a time where I could truly, deeply feel
the power that comes from the interplay of loving and being loved.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's what LOVE is!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Love is about affirming the other person.
At times giving them a push, becoming their driving force."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The feeling I am always able to experience,
thanks to all my fans—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
If you could feel it too, Trainer-kun,
I'd be so happy!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "If you felt it too, Trainer-chan, then I'm super happy!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Ordinary, simple—yet filled with abundant love and rich moments.
I quietly savor the preciousness of it all."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, I feel the same way.
However...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It's not just today.
Always... every single day."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No matter what time it is, every moment I spend
with you makes me so happy, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No matter what time it is, every moment I spend
with you makes me so happy, Trainer-chan.
